items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: Midget Harrison... was one of them and Rex Rajak was the other violin. And this was in a, what they then called the 6 and 7 8s.

ctx.x: That works out very well with the lower register clarinet that Pinky used to play on the records. You have to hear all those records. Those records are still great. When they go back to the two string instruments you can get some feeling of what the Invincibles and the old 6 and 7 8s must have sounded like. But they'd never been a violin on those records.

No, I remember the first time I went to the 6 and 7 8s was playing at a two lane night. And they had two violins in it at that time. And this was playing on the old two lane stage if I'm not mistaken. I'm trying to think. Midget Harrison, who people used to confuse with me and Vice Facer all the time because both little runts we both played the violin was one of them and Rex Rajak was the other violin. And this was in a, what they then called the 6 and 7 8s. I think Midget was the 7 8s. The origin of the name.…
